item.text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested","findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality uses != instead of hmac.compare_digest.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14; testable observation: the module never imports or calls hmac.compare_digest.","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are not validated, and raw prefix matching can authorize out-of-scope paths.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16-18; testable observation: root \"services/api\" authorizes \"services/api-evil/config.py\", and malformed paths or roots can pass.","claim_ids":["x2","x3","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources and actions are ignored; malformed records can also raise an exception instead of being denied.","evidence":"release_policy.py:17-19; testable observation: a rename from \"private/secret\" into an allowed root passes, an unknown action passes, and a record without \"path\" raises KeyError.","claim_ids":["x4","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"An empty root set is accepted when there are no changes.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16-19; testable observation: release_allowed(\"a\", \"a\", [], []) returns True.","claim_ids":["x5"]}]}
